findings.text: two quoted values resolve against a superseded reading rather than the transcript the report names: the report quotes elapsed 6:17:17 and session-152862.scope (:46) from the 11:35 run of capture.sh, while gate.log was overwritten by the 11:40 re-run and now carries 6:22:22 (:10) and session-152874.scope (:29), so a reader checking the receipt finds different numbers than the claim beside them.

item_verdicts.diff: there is no diff - the review worktree is clean at base 5e472aa83b2f277abc47f39ee0fb622a4a6a4120 (I checked rev-parse HEAD and git status --porcelain there), so the landed change is the report and its transcript, both outside version control.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when (prompt.txt:51-54) requires three executed hostname readings and a plain statement of the match; placed-worker-host.md:12-30 gives the three readings, :34-40 states the match to fleet status and the non-match to the login node, and gate.log:3,15,28 carry each value as command output rather than as prose.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal (prompt.txt:24-25) is that a dispatched worker reports which host it runs on so placement is established from inside the worker; the report at ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/imas-ambix/placed-worker-host.md does exactly that and concludes the worker is inside held allocation 1276262 on 98dci4-clu-2002 while the login node is a different host.
item_verdicts.manifest: read and audited; tests, test_logs, negative_control and artifacts are accurate against gate.log, and changed_paths is emptied with the reckon scope-root limitation stated in follow_ons rather than left to fail at promotion.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared exclusive scope (prompt.txt:30-31) is the single report path; the report is there, capture.sh and gate.log sit in the run directory the role owns, and no repository file was touched.

justifications.durability: nothing reddens if the wrapper stops placing workers - placed-worker-host.md:52-57 records the login-side reading only as a positive control that the instrument is not reading nothing.
justifications.evidence: gate.log's worker hostname is produced by the worker process itself rather than by a command run on another host - stream.jsonl:1194 records a bare hostname in the worker's own Bash context printing 98dci4-clu-2002.iter.org thirteen minutes before capture.sh ran, the same shell's /proc/self/cgroup (gate.log:4) and SLURM_JOB_ID (gate.log:6) place it in slurmstepd step job_1276262/step_3, and the only value in the log produced on another host is the explicitly labelled login line from the ssh at capture.sh:33-36.
justifications.fit: capture.sh:1-8 names each value by the mechanism that produced it, and no filename, symbol or comment carries a plan, sprint or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: placed-worker-host.md:9-30 answers the goal's question from the worker's own reading rather than from the plan's configuration.
justifications.scope_discipline: every artefact of the run sits at a path the declared scope or the role's run directory owns, and the review worktree's HEAD is unchanged at 5e472aa8.
